core_obligations: After the cited Saliola/Aguiar–Mahajan face-algebra/cohomology correspondence, Sundaram partition-lattice representations and product-homology theorem, Wachs plethystic induction formula and Gessel–Reutenauer necklace interpretation, the author still explicitly constructs the evaluation-preserving Lyndon block-necklace bijection with a primitive inverse, classifies the general pair-orbits by multiset partitions and their intersected stabilizers, and tracks determinant/parity twists so that the general equivariant interval decomposition has the required wreath-product character. These constructions connect upper-interval Lie characters to arbitrary double-idempotent components and the simultaneous symmetric-group/descent-algebra composition formula. This gives one nonroutine H2 combinatorial-representation construction; routine tensor reassociation, coefficient extraction and the final Euler-product manipulation are supporting steps, not the difficulty basis. The old H3 reason based only on a 32-line final assembly and external pointer count is retained as history; the current complete result is screened H2 with this concrete core, not one count per supporting lemma.
